val: Fohenagh vs Claregalway — 1941 county junior semi-final
1941 Galway junior hurling semi-final, played May 1942

Fohenagh met Claregalway in the 1941 county junior semi-final at Athenry in May 1942. A History of Fohenagh dates the day 23 May (p.144). The Connacht Tribune fixture of 23 May 1942, page 10, gives Sunday 24 May at 4.30 p.m. The referee's report in the Connacht Tribune of 13 June 1942 and the Connacht Sentinel of 9 June 1942 says the game began as hard hurling, spectators came onto the pitch, some Fohenagh players were hurt, and the match was called off. The County Board suspended both clubs for a year, and Eyrecourt were declared 1941 junior champions. At that meeting Mr M. Silver of Ardrahan spoke of powerful panzer divisions behind some teams (Connacht Tribune, 13 June 1942; Connacht Sentinel, 9 June 1942).
A History of Fohenagh p.144; Connacht Tribune 23 May 1942 p.10; Connacht Tribune 13 June 1942; Connacht Sentinel 9 June 1942

The Tuam Herald of 6 October 1956 headlined this game Five men went to hospital. The report says it was abandoned after about 25 minutes, with Fohenagh leading by 7 points at the stoppage. The scoreline is otherwise not fully printed.
The final that waited a year
Fohenagh vs Tynagh — Junior hurling, Kiltormer, 1956

A History of Fohenagh (p.148) records a Junior A game at Kiltormer on 15 July 1956 in which Fohenagh led Tynagh by seven points to nil when the game was called off. Both teams were suspended for twelve months. The Tuam Herald of 6 October 1956, page 5, is the printed report of Fohenagh against Tynagh at Kiltormer.
A History of Fohenagh p.148; Tuam Herald 6 Oct 1956 p.5
